problem_to_correct: Progress summaries and next-step suggestions were incorrectly treated as confirmation gates, causing continuous construction to stop.
execution_rules: When the user has authorized continuous construction, do not ask whether to continue after each round.
Read the current construction panel and latest startup package at the beginning of each round.
Only perform W1/R0 low-risk shadow construction inside the video production shadow base.
Self-check and create an alignment handoff record after each round.
A handoff record is not a stop point; continue to the next low-risk candidate unless a redline is triggered.
Register blockers only when a redline appears.
When material, account, real configuration, or user content is missing, create gap cards, pending-review questions, or placeholder templates.
turn_boundary_note: Within a single tool-execution turn, continue multiple low-risk small tasks. If the interaction protocol requires a user-facing response, report completed work and queued next candidates rather than asking the user to confirm continuation.
